title: Tableau Prep Conductor Flow Failures
dataSources: Tableau Server logs (`tableau:backgrounder`, `tableau:vizqlserver`, `tableau:httpd`), `workgroup` repository tables (`background_jobs`, `http_requests`, `_views_stats`, `licensing`) via DB Connect, Tableau Cloud Admin Insights / Activity Log exports.
app: Splunk DB Connect (Splunkbase 2686) against the Tableau Server `workgroup` PostgreSQL repository; Tableau Server logs via Universal Forwarder; Tableau Server REST API and TSM metrics via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:backgrounder job_type=run_flow
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(finish_code!=0)) as failures, latest(finish_code) as last_code by flow_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Tracks Tableau Prep Conductor flow runs and flags data-prep flows that fail, which break the extracts and dashboards downstream of them.
value: A failed Prep flow starves every dashboard built on its output; catching flow failures protects the whole downstream chain of Tableau content.
implementation: Ingest Backgrounder run_flow events; schedule hourly and alert. Map each flow to the workbooks it feeds for impact analysis.
visualization: Table of failing flows, timechart of flow failures.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the data-preparation steps that feed your Tableau reports so a broken one is caught before it spoils everything built on top of it.
